async function haveFiveRawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {
    // This process checks if the player already possesses five iron ingots. If not, it determines how many more are required and verifies that enough raw iron is available. It then locates or places a furnace block nearby. Next, it searches for a suitable fuel source, such as coal or wood planks, to meet the smelting needs. Finally, it initiates the smelting of the raw iron into ingots and confirms that the target amount has been reached.
}
